text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- The Portuguese government fears that the future enlargement of the European Union may reduce EU funds for Portugal after 1999.
- Banco Finantia boosts activities in Brazil.
- Telecel and TMN, the two companies operating mobile telephone services in Portugal, expect to post profits totalling 11 billion escudos in 1996.
- Portuguese companies are the slowest in the European Union to pay suppliers, a study says.
- Secretary of State for Employment, Monteiro Fernandes, believes that in the future there will be more self-employed people and fewer salaried workers.
